title: Constitutional Review

goal: I can give the reason for a decision with *jogbiztonsági okból* or *alkotmányossági szempontból*.

I can use the main words of constitutional review: *normakontroll*, *megsemmisítés*, *jogbiztonság elve*.

sections.title: Unit 32: The Constitution and Fundamental Rights
body: Constitutional courts decide whether laws respect fundamental rights, and their vocabulary is long and exact. In this unit you recap forms you already know (stance adverbials, participles before a noun, cause, the past conditional) and use them with the vocabulary of constitutional review.

The unit does not discuss current constitutional questions. It names terms and the work of the Hungarian Constitutional Court in the early 1990s. The reading is a short original text about Sólyom László and his idea of the *láthatatlan alkotmány*.
